# SkyRewardsArk

## SkyRewardsArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/SkyRewardsArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[Ark](../ark.md)

**Title:**
SkyRewardsArk

Ark that swaps the fleet asset to USDS via the Lite PSM and stakes
the USDS in a Sky StakingRewards contract, harvesting the reward token


### State Variables
#### TO_18_DECIMALS_CONVERSION_FACTOR
Factor scaling the fleet asset's amount up to USDS's 18 decimals


```solidity
uint256 public immutable TO_18_DECIMALS_CONVERSION_FACTOR
```


#### litePsm
The LitePSM contract for fleet asset -> USDS swaps


```solidity
ILitePSM public immutable litePsm
```


#### usds
The USDS token contract


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable usds
```


#### stakingRewards
The staking rewards contract


```solidity
IStakingRewards public immutable stakingRewards
```


#### rewardsToken
the rewards token


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable rewardsToken
```


#### lazySummerReferralCode
Lazy Summer governance referral code


```solidity
uint16 public immutable lazySummerReferralCode
```


### Functions
#### constructor


```solidity
constructor(address _litePsm, address _usds, address _stakingRewards, ArkParams memory _params) Ark(_params);
```

#### totalAssets


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256 assets);
```

#### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

Returns the staked USDS balance converted to the fleet asset's
decimals (accrued, unclaimed rewards are intentionally excluded). It
does NOT account for available LitePSM buyGem liquidity, so a
withdrawal can still fail at the PSM step if the PSM lacks gem.


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```

#### _board

Swaps the fleet asset to USDS via the Lite PSM and stakes it in the rewards contract


```solidity
function _board(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```

#### _disembark

Unstakes USDS from the rewards contract and swaps it back to the fleet asset via the Lite PSM


```solidity
function _disembark(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```

#### _validateBoardData

Validates the board data (no-op; this Ark requires no board data)


```solidity
function _validateBoardData(bytes calldata) internal pure override;
```

#### _validateDisembarkData

Validates the disembark data (no-op; this Ark requires no disembark data)


```solidity
function _validateDisembarkData(bytes calldata) internal pure override;
```

#### _harvest

Claims the staking reward token and forwards it to the raft()


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```

